search_window.basis: Conservative overlap from the most recent independently read-back-verified prior heartbeat (2026-10-29 21:49:09 PDT start, 21:50:19 PDT completion). More recent hourly executions have not been independently enumerated. Candidate evidence must show a newly published/updated disruption or direct official notice within this local-time window; search index recency alone does not qualify.

coverage_notes: Supplementary bounded Food Line recall watch only. Production nationwide collection remains authoritative and was not modified.

Completed 12 targeted web queries (3 sole/last/full-service grocery loss, 2 emergency distribution cancellation, 3 pantry/food-bank closure or severe access reduction, 3 SNAP/WIC/EBT interruption, 1 disaster/territory-focused cancellation). No search transport failures surfaced.

No newly reported, source-dated qualifying disruption in the bounded window was verified; this is not an assertion of nationwide absence. Many results were historical, prior-year, or unrelated and were excluded.

October 29, 2026 Kauaʻi Now Hurricane Lowell bulletin explicitly says Hawaiʻi Foodbank Kauaʻi emergency mobile distribution on Friday, October 30, 4–5 p.m. at Hale Līhuʻe remains scheduled, not canceled: https://kauainownews.com/2026/10/29/what-kaua%CA%BBi-county-residents-visitors-need-to-know-thursday-about-hurricane-lowell-recovery/

Ruby's Pantry closure result, Pierce County Journal posted April 15–16, 2026, pertains to a March 30, 2026 closure, not a new October interruption: https://www.piercecountyjournal.news/stories/rubys-pantry-suddenly-ceases-operations-including-ellsworth-site,186312

Massachusetts DTA EBT vendor transition interruption was April 26–27, 2025; despite a September 2026 page update it does not qualify as a fresh October 30 incident: https://www.mass.gov/info-details/ebt-vendor-change-important-information

Search indexing latency, recency mismatch and absence of some local agency notices can hide events. No approvals, public publication, social posting, production changes, schedule edits or task disabling occurred.
